failure_criteria: Workflow identity or model class differs from the fixture.
A dependency references a missing step.
A required gauntlet gate is skipped without an explicit review.
A live side effect occurs during the core evaluation.
objective: Verify the Critical Path Hardening workflow identity, DAG shape, and record-only contract.
scenario: Run SO-029 against a deterministic fixture without network, shell, credential, or destructive adapters.
success_criteria: Step identifiers are unique and dependencies resolve.
The workflow is able to verify the extra HIGH and CRITICAL gates are present before a high-risk release.
The run contract requires one evidence record.
